title: Baby Monitor Rona Samajhta Nahi, Bas Volume Dekhta Hai #shorts
description:
Ek chhota sa mic baby ke rone par parents ko kaise jagata hai? Yeh Short sound sensor module ko 3D mein andar se dikhata hai.
🎤 Electret mic capsule ki jhilli kaise hilti hai
⚡ LM393 comparator aur blue pot ka threshold
🔌 Arduino Uno wiring: VCC 5V, DO D2
💡 Cheap monitor sirf volume dekhte hain, cry nahi samajhte
Aise aur maker videos ke liye subscribe karo.
#shorts #arduino #soundsensor #babymonitor #electronics #hindi #maker
